Name: Make New Farmhouse
Author: slpOff
Description:
[b]Make New Farmhouse[/b] lets you choose your farmhouse interior on the character creation screen when starting a new game. When building a cabin, choose its interior before placing it. In multiplayer, the host makes the selection.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Make New Farmhouse.[/*]
[*]Place each interior pack in the MakeNewFarmhouse/Farmhouses folder. Create the Farmhouses folder if it’s missing.[/*]
[*]Check each pack’s requirements and install any dependencies, such as Content Patcher, directly in your Mods folder.[/*]
[/list]
[code]
Mods/
├─ Content Patcher/ (if required)
└─ MakeNewFarmhouse/
  └─ Farmhouses/
      └─ Your Interior Pack/
        ├─ manifest.json
        └─ content.json[/code]
Keep only one copy of each interior pack, inside [b]Farmhouses[/b]. Make New Farmhouse automatically renames each pack’s manifest.json to prevent SMAPI from loading the pack separately.

Some features may be unavailable depending on the interior pack.

Manifest.Name: Make New Farmhouse
Manifest.Description: Adds movable farmhouse fixtures and supports custom farmhouse layouts.
